text:
alicia: quick RFC follow-up: proposing namespace-owned shard overlays for safetensors. owner publishes a signed compact manifest; adopters reference owner manifest instead of a global registry to reduce churn.
raja: how do we avoid hotstart storms for shared embeddings?
alicia: include adopt_qos + prefetch_budget in manifest; owners expose a /warmup-credit endpoint so adopters are rate-limited.
morgan: owner outage fallback -> try peer-fetch (recent adopters), then CDN. manifests MUST be signed; loader verifies signature before mapping critical shards.
jen: mark shards with "critical" flag. critical shards require sync verify; non-critical can be mounted optimistically with async verify and a signature cache.
taylor: keep manifests compact (small JSON) for hot fetches; full debug manifest behind auth. metrics to add: adopter_prefetch_rate, owner_credit_qps, peer_fallback_rate, verify_latency.
warmup-bot: canary scheduled: /canary/adopt-overlay-v1 in 2h.
Action items: @raja implement warmup-credit endpoint, @morgan add manifest sidecar + loader verify PR, @jen runtime QoS knobs + tests, @taylor dashboards/canary plan.
